answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents register through a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. New identities bind to an interlocking trellis of verified reputations, while an automated protocol acts as a digital quill recording escalating stake requirements. This forces exponential capital exhaustion: each duplicate identity doubles bonding fees into a resilient reserve as dense as shale, rendering Sybil swarms superlinearly cost-prohibitive.
